C1305.title: Jinhua Ge Mou Large-Scale Fake Investment Platform Fraud Case
C1305.summary: A major cross-border telecom network fraud case jointly supervised by the SPP and the Ministry of Public Security was disclosed in December 2024. From 2019 to 2020, a fraud group led by Zhao and Zhang (both handled separately) set up teams in Cambodia for traffic diversion, lecturing, operations, and money laundering, recruiting over 400 people. Ge, as the second-tier 'team boss,' funded a business team that lured victims into group chats via free courses and stock recommendations, then induced them to invest on fake stock investment platforms with 'many-on-one' role-play, controlling prices and restricting withdrawals to defraud over 500 victims of more than 140 million yuan. From December 2021 to May 2024, Jinhua courts at two levels sentenced Ge to life imprisonment, team leaders Liu, Li and 8 others to fixed-term imprisonment of 10 years and 3 months to 14 years, and another 379 people to prison.
